description_en: Creates a category in a specified workspace to classify and manage files. Each workspace supports a maximum of 500 categories
description_zh: 在指定的业务空间中创建一个类目，用于分类和管理文件。每个业务空间最多创建500个类目
kebab_example: aliyun bailian add-category --workspace-id llm-3z7uw7fwz0vxxxx --category-name '产品清单' --category-type UNSTRUCTURED --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCategory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace where you want to create the category. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID，即在该业务空间中新增类目。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the category. The name must be 1 to 20 characters long. It can contain Unicode letters, such as English letters and Chinese characters, along with digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 类目名称。长度为 1~20 个字符，支持 Unicode 中 letter 分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: category_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the category. Valid value:

UNSTRUCTURED: A category
parameters.help_zh:
类目类型。取值范围：
UNSTRUCTURED：类目
parameters.name: category_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent category under which the new category is created. If you leave this parameter empty, a top-level category is created
parameters.help_zh: 父类目的类目 ID。在此父类目下创建新类目，此值为空时创建一级类目
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the connector instance. You can obtain the ID from the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console
parameters.help_zh: 所属数据连接（Connector）的实例id，请到百炼控制台获取
parameters.name: connector_id

CategoryId.description_en: The ID of the category. Save this ID for future API calls that use this category
CategoryId.description_zh: 类目 ID。请妥善保管该值，它将用于后续所有与此类目相关的API操作

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。 
false：失败
